scenario: First launch with the fictional sample files; list events and open demand report
actual: 3 events listed by date; report: 3 open events, 3 registrations, 1.7% occupancy

scenario: Create a valid event in a free venue
actual: Event E004 created and saved to events.csv (4 rows)

scenario: New event starts exactly when another ends in the same venue
expected: Accepted: half-open intervals allow back-to-back events
actual: New 13:00-14:00 event accepted next to E001 (ends 13:00) in the same venue

scenario: New event overlaps an existing one; venue typed in different letter case
actual: Blocked: 'Venue conflict with E001' (venue typed in lower case); events.csv unchanged

scenario: Impossible date, bad time, end before start, zero capacity, non-numeric capacity
expected: Each input rejected with a clear message; nothing saved
actual: Each of 5 bad inputs rejected with its own message; no event saved

scenario: Register a student for an open event with seats left
actual: Registered as R004; 'Seats left: 59'; row appended to registrations.csv

scenario: Same student ID registers twice for the same event
actual: Blocked: 'already registered for E001'; registrations.csv unchanged

scenario: Fill an event to capacity, then try one more registration
input: New event with capacity 1; register two different students
expected: First accepted; second rejected as full
actual: 1st student accepted; 2nd blocked: 'Event E004 is full (1/1 seats)'
Blocked: 'Email address looks invalid'; nothing saved

input: Cancel E002 (y); then register for E002

scenario: Non-numeric, out-of-range and empty menu choices
expected: Invalid option message each time; no crash
